Submission checklist¶

  1. Extract the prepared project to a new folder, preserving its .git directory.

  2. Run the application or the test suite from that extracted folder.

  3. Run the Docker checks in SUBMISSION_STEPS.md. These require Docker Desktop.

  4. Publish main, docs and container to your public GitHub repository.

  5. Check that GitHub shows the updated README, Dockerfile and generated HTML.

  6. Check capstone.txt contains the actual public repository URL.

  7. Upload the requested project files and capstone.txt to the course task folder.

  8. Select Request review only after the checks pass.

Keep .env, databases and virtual environments private. Do not submit old duplicate archives or snippets. The prepared repository has local Git commits; uploading files through GitHub’s web interface alone will not preserve the branch history.
